rationale: PROVISIONAL: schema-complete placeholders for the tail-equivalence workflow (#58), not yet reviewed against real cross-platform CI evidence. Per docs/adr/0001-cross-platform-reproducibility.md, tolerances are only tightened after reviewing float and double evidence from every supported CI architecture (macOS arm64, macOS Intel, Windows x86_64) for the compact tail CI tracer (tests/test_tail_equivalence_cli.py); each committed value must then state its own observed delta and measured headroom, mirroring diffusion_tolerances_v1.json's issue #37 precedent. These placeholders are deliberately generous so the workflow itself is exercised without masking a real divergence before that review happens.

nonFiniteSampleCount.rationale: PROVISIONAL. Expected to reproduce with exactly zero delta, mirroring diffusion's alignmentMinimum/alignmentMean precedent -- a non-finite sample is a discrete numerical-hygiene failure, not a floating-point accumulation. To be reviewed against real CI evidence.

decayRt60Sec.rationale: PROVISIONAL placeholder covering every octave band's T20/T30 RT60 estimate (seconds). Schroeder integration, octave-band FFT filtering, and linear regression all run in NumPy float64 regardless of DSP sample precision, so cross-platform drift is expected to resemble diffusion's Coloration entries (1e-16-to-1e-15 scale) rather than this placeholder's 0.01s headroom. To be tightened after reviewing real CI evidence.

alignmentScore.rationale: PROVISIONAL. Expected to reproduce with exactly zero delta, mirroring diffusion's alignmentMinimum/alignmentMean precedent -- Alignment is a discrete Jaccard overlap of active-frame sets, not a floating-point accumulation. To be reviewed against real CI evidence.
